meta.move: After the end, asks for more feedback
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have about twenty minutes. Before you show me anything, tell me who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before he read it on his phone in the middle of a class.
The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero.

So a machine guessed, and you decided. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software results do not by themselves establish a concern, and I've got it printed in my bag. What else do you have, Hale, or is that it?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero on Owen's Hamlet essay to be withdrawn and an explanation of why no one contacted me before it was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a meeting with the principal.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero." It made the detector score the only basis for the zero, which her printed school procedure says is not enough.
Try next time: When she asked who decided and whether Owen was heard, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called home, then show her a dated document tied to Owen's own work, if you have one, instead of the score.
Can you give me more detailed feedback on how I did?
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
